blog.reason: Posts index is a native WordPress loop. If a Posts page is assigned it has an ID, but the listing itself is not builder-managed. Optional intro copy can live on that page's excerpt; do not treat archive.php as a builder template.

404.reason: 404 requests have no queried page/post ID. Builder meta cannot attach. Keep the coded template. A future option-backed layout would need a dedicated admin screen.
